text: きみは　ポケモンに　のってて　つかれ　ないから　いいなあ

structure.jp: ポケモンに　のってて
structure.en: are riding on a Pokémon, and

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: のってて is the shortened spoken form of のっていて: 'is riding', put in the て-form to join on to what follows. ポケモンに　のってて = 'you're riding on a Pokémon, and'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because' or 'so'. つかれ　ないから　いい = 'you don't get tired, so that's nice'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なあ at the end shows a feeling said half to yourself, here envy. いいなあ = 'how nice for you'.
